'''Second officer''' was a person third in command of a [[Starship/Legends|starship]]. [[Second Lieutenant/Legends|Second lieutenant]] [[Alfonso Luiz Obota]] was the second officer aboard the [[Alliance Special Operations/Legends|Alliance Special Operations]] [[Transport/Legends|transport]] [[Spirit of Solaris|''Pride of Aridus'']].
